about: AP Physics 1 concept dependency map (docs/apphys-spec.md, docs/apphys-phase0.md): the 43 CED topics in CED order, the "Math you need" skills with the topic each comes before, and every concept with the topic that teaches it and the concepts it depends on. circularDependencies.problem: Free-body diagrams (2.2) need the downward pull of Earth on every object before 2.6 teaches gravitational force and the gravitational field.
circularDependencies.detail: A short version: near Earth's surface the Earth pulls every object down with a force of size mg (the weight), drawn from the center of mass and labelled "F_g, Earth on block". 2.6 owns Newton's law of gravitation, the field g = F/m and apparent weight.
